name: My Wonderful Life
description: The series, full of intrigue, love, tension and excitement, tells the shocking story of Şebnem, who came to life with great injustices, worked hard to overcome them, did what was necessary on this path, and is now trying to get rid of her criminal past that came and found her while she was living a wonderful life.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A gifted young woman defies societal injustice by turning to crime. Seeking a better life, she builds a family but her dark past resurfaces, forcing her to fight for survival while rewriting her story.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Sebnem's life spirals after Niyazi's return. Her wound worsens as Onur acts strange. Her life crumbles but she persists. She lobbies to be society queen but pushes Aysel's limit. Will Sebnem's Izmir past catch up?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Mesut won't let Sebnem go. Investigating her past in Izmir, going back to his old school, and even talking to Arzu, is Mesut really about to solve the mystery of this socialite and glittering woman? Or will the mysterious stranger who follows him all the way to Istanbul lead Mesut down a completely different and complicated path? Sebnem, on the other hand, has a lot on her plate. Since the day Niyazi appeared in front of her, this wonderful life she built with great sacrifices has been leaking.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sebnem's patience has run out. Melisa's being right under her nose was the last straw for Sebnem. She has two paths in front of her: Either she will confront Onur and ask him to pay for her broken heart or... She will go head to head with Didem and get rid of Melisa. Will Sebnem, who is very hurt, be able to control herself and give Melisa what she deserves? Melisa did not listen to Aysel and challenged Sebnem. Aysel, who has repeatedly warned her not to disobey her, does not know what to do in the face of the daring behavior of her favorite bride-to-be.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: How will Sebnem, who is dependent on Mesut's care due to a high infection, explain the wound inflicted by Niyazi to Mesut? Mesut, who has been suspicious of Sebnem all along, finally gets the clue he's been looking for and goes after Sebnem with all his might, but what will stop him? Melisa is determined to get Onur. But with a formidable opponent like Sebnem in front of her, her job is very difficult. So let her raise her hand, stir things up a bit more, get in Sebnem's face and challenge her in her own house.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sebnem and Onur are shocked to see this unexpected couple, but the night has to go on... No one can reveal their true feelings. Around the elegant dinner table, everyone will play their own game, and things will get more complicated than ever between the four. During this action-packed dinner, Melisa drops the bombshell that she and Mesut are getting engaged and falls into the hands of Sebnem. Sebnem does not miss this opportunity and pulls Melisa into her own game arena. Not letting her rival breathe, Sebnem shows Istanbul, Melisa, and Aysel who the real queen is. Melisa, on the other hand, will not be idle and will take action to fight back against Sebnem.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sebnem is always in trouble. When she wakes up in the morning, she is surprised to see municipality workers digging in the garden of her house. When she learns that the excavation work will pass through Niyazi's grave, Sebnem doesn't know what to do. is this the end of the road? Mesut feels responsible to Sebnem for the game he played with Melisa. He decides to confront Onur and talk to him. However, this conversation goes to a place he never expected, and in a surprise development, the four of them find themselves on vacation. Will this vacation take Mesut and Sebnem's relationship to a different level? Onur is very confused because Melisa stipulates divorce... What event will change Onur's mind as he thinks about the consequences of his decision and does not want to divorce?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Sebnem learns that Onur wants a divorce. However, she has no intention of leaving quietly, especially without her children. Gümüsçüler will pay a heavy price for going behind Sebnem's back. Sebnem puts her plan into action, and the ground shakes for Gümüsçüler. Mesut is caught between his profession and Sebnem. While one part of him wants to pursue the smallest clue, the other part wants Sebnem to be innocent. But Sebnem's moves throw him to a place he never expected. Will Mesut have to sacrifice his profession for his love for Sebnem? Izbandut finally caught Sebnem. Will Izbandut, who went to Izmir and found her at the hospital where she underwent surgery, let Sebnem, who has information that could send them to prison forever, live? Or will Sebnem, who is fighting on other fronts, reach the end of the road?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Everyone knows about Sebnem's past.Mesut checks the cameras and finds out that Niazi's killer is Sebnem. When he talkes to her, he realizes that Sebnam is the same girl in Izmir, and kisses her. At the same time the police arrive.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Mesut faces a dilemma after confessing love to Sebnem. Melisa moves in, aiming to be a mother figure against Sebnem's wishes. Selo uncovers Sebnem's past, concocting a plan. Amid her divorce, Sebnem encounters surprising reactions.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Learning about his past connection with Sebnem, Selo decides to confront Sebnem. Mesut, who puts the duo under surveillance, is stunned when he sees Sebnem side by side with his worst enemy. On the other hand, Aysel is determined to reveal all of Sebnem's dirty laundry. So she decides to play a dangerous game with Sebnem's family. Melisa uses Sebnem's anger towards her to get Onur on her side and gets an important position in the company. Sebnem's revenge on Melisa will be bitter. And this move will drop like a bomb on the Gümüsçü family.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: With the arrival of Melisa's husband Ahmet, Onur realizes that he has a life of lies. Aysel is determined to hit Sebnem with her past. Unable to get what she wants from Seda and Harun, Aysel continues to dig into Sebnem's past. Meanwhile, Onur, who is aware of Mesut and Sebnem's rapprochement, goes crazy with jealousy. Melisa, who is aware of this situation, has a plan ready to bring Onur to his knees. While Selo continues to squeeze Sebnem about Mesut, Sebnem, who feels herself at a dead end, unexpectedly takes her breath at Mesut's side. Will Sebnem's fate change when she tells Mesut the truth?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: After Sebnem's confession, Mesut chooses between his profession and his love. The images of Sebnem and Mesut leaked to the press, creating a new crisis in Onur and Sebnem's relationship; with Onur's strong moves, this crisis turned into a big war. Sebnem once again faces the danger of being separated from her children. The rivalry between Aysel and Ece gains a new dimension with the secret Aysel learns. Ece, who is cornered with this information learned by Aysel, comes to the brink of an important decision. Melisa makes a plan to get rid of Ahmet-this time, she has to succeed. Mesut's dangerous plan to end Selo will bring him to the brink.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Sebnem falls into a big struggle again after Onur's threat over the children. Mesut seeks ways to silence Selo and Izzet in order to protect Sebnem and avenge his dead friend. A new era will begin for Mesut, who makes an important decision after what happened. Melisa's unexpected move changes the course of the divorce case. The images obtained by Onur make things more complicated. Things come to a breaking point between Onur and Aysel. Will Sebnem be able to emerge victorious from this struggle with the Gümüsçü family?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Aysel's big secret is discovered by Sebnem, who offers her a deal. Melisa decides to expose the truth about Sebnem. With the support of an unexpected ally, things once again become complicated for Sebnem. Mesut, who has quit the police force, starts a new life, leading to a new conflict between Onur and Mesut. Sebnem's clever move turns into a major crisis between Onur and Aysel. The Gümüsçü family is on the verge of falling apart. Sebnem confronts the big game being played against her. Will Sebnem be able to weather this storm?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Sebnem's hospitalization drops like a bomb on the agenda. As public opinion is shaken by this news, Mesut takes action to save Sebnem from this situation. The tension between Onur and Aysel increases when Aysel brings Demir home. The arrival of an unexpected guest complicates things for Melisa. Sebnem, who puts her revenge plan into action, is determined to make her pay for being locked in the hospital. Onur, who learns about Niyazi's murder, starts to corner Sebnem. After all these events, Sebnem is on the verge of a big crossroads.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Things take an unexpected turn for Sebnem as she prepares for a new life with her children. Onur's discovery of Niyazi's murder has a shock effect on Sebnem. Looking for ways to get out of this vortex she has fallen into, Sebnem's biggest supporter will be Mesut again.Ahmet has gotten what he wanted from Melisa. Ahmet's new job at Gümüsçü Holding makes things more complicated for everyone. While the Gümüsçü's are fighting their own internal war, Sebnem has already started to plan for revenge. Will Sebnem's plan open the doors to a new life for everyone?

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: While Onur's detention due to corruption allegations resonates widely with the public, Sebnem ignites a new war in the Gümüsçü family. A management crisis emerges at Gümüsçü Holding. After Aysel's critical decision, a great struggle begins between Onur, Aysel, and Demir. Onur, who is looking for ways to get out of all this, comes to Sebnem with an offer. The deal Sebnem makes with Onur will bring her one step closer to her goal and put her relationship with Mesut in a deadlock. Nilgün, on the other hand, has another plan for Mesut. Will the guest from the past change the balance in Sebnem's life?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Mesut and Elif become partners. While this news brings a smile to Nilgün and Arzu's faces, it comes as a shock to Sebnem. In the Gümüsçü family, things get complicated. The chairmanship election of the board of directors is on the agenda. Aysel wants Demir to be the chairman despite Onur's reaction. Onur is cornered by Aysel's move and has to ask for help from Sebnem. Sebnem, who is looking for ways to win Mesut back, does not miss this opportunity. She has only one condition to help Onur. To become a free woman. Will Onur accept this condition?

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: After an assassination attempt on Sebnem, Mesut investigates suspects. A dinner honoring Sebnem's presidency causes a scandal. Onur confronts Demir, forcing Sebnem to make a choice amid her strained relationship with Mesut.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Onur seeks Sebnem's aid to dispose of Demir's body, fearing imprisonment. Sebnem is aghast. Her choice will impact the Gümüsçü family's future. Aysel thinks Demir fled after trying to kill Sebnem. She searches for him, aided by an ally.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Sebnem is still reeling from the shock of Mesut's slander when she receives a threatening message on her phone. While Sebnem tries to find ways to clear Mesut, she is also aware that time is running out to find the blackmailer. Mesut is taken into custody after Elif's plot. Mesut, who is looking for ways to make a deal with Elif, is in a difficult situation when Elif makes him an offer. But Mesut has a plan. While Onur and Sebnem have convinced everyone that Demir has escaped, the arrival of Demir's father, Macit, turns everything upside down. Thinking that something bad has happened to his son, Macit targets Sebnem. Will Sebnem, who is stuck in the middle of all these events, find a way out?

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Sebnem and Onur, who act together to find the witness of Demir's murder, are shocked to learn that Didem is the blackmailer. Sebnem thinks that her best friend would never betray her, but Onur disagrees. Mesut, who suspects that Sebnem and Onur are acting together, is shaken by a mysterious message on his phone. Mesut's move changes the course of events. Macit learns about Elif's enmity towards Sebnem. The alliance between Macit and Elif will be the beginning of difficult days for Sebnem. Sebnem needs Mesut's help to get out of this bind she has fallen into. Will Mesut help Sebnem once again?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Learning about the murder, Elif goes to the police. Aysel and Macit are devastated to learn that Demir is dead. Sebnem is faced with Elif framing her for the murder. She has no choice but to crush Elif. The police dig Demir's grave and find an unexpected truth. On the other side, Onur feels cornered as Melisa starts her wedding preparations and gets closer to Didem. This intimacy will turn into a scandal when Ahmet sees them. Melisa, who learns about Onur and Didem's relationship, has a big surprise for Onur on the wedding night. Sebnem, who is preparing to build a new life for herself, is surprised to learn about Didem and Onur's relationship. This time, Sebnem will be tested by the betrayal of her best friend. But she will have an unexpected ally by her side... Melisa.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Didem, whose images with Onur were leaked, takes action against Sebnem and Melisa and shares a video targeting both of them. This video causes a huge stir on social media. Unable to stomach the video, Sebnem decides to hit Didem, where it hurts the most, and takes Mange from her. Onur, on the other hand, traps Ahmet, who recorded the footage of him with Didem. Cornered, Ahmet seeks help from Mesut. Losing Mange, Didem becomes even more determined to get revenge and pressures Onur to take Sebnem's house. Already not wanting Sebnem to live in the house, Onur sends her an eviction notice. Mesut once again comes to Sebnem's rescue in her desperate situation. As Sebnem and Melisa unite to fight against Didem, nothing will ever be the same again.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: After Sebnem and Melisa set the house on fire, the tension between them and Didem escalates. Didem reports Sebnem and Melisa to the police. However, Sebnem and Melisa have no intention of backing down. Mesut, worried about Sebnem getting hurt, sternly warns Didem. Believing she has intimidated Didem, Sebnem prepares for her wedding with Mesut. However, Didem discovers their biggest secrets. Shaken by Didem learning about the murder, Onur is forced to make a choice in response to Didem's offer. Unaware of the truth, Sebnem prepares for the wedding, only to face a nasty surprise from Didem. Will Didem be able to achieve victory against Sebnem?

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: A poor girl, she want to change her life by marriage to a rich guy.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Sebnem and Melisa retaliate against Didem's war declaration. Losing compassion after her children were threatened, Sebnem targets Didem's weakness. Didem faces a shocking revelation. Sebnem and Melisa gain an unexpected ally.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Didem, who framed Sebnem and Mesut, is sure that she will get custody of the children. But there is something she did not calculate. Sebnem has already taken precautions in this regard. Sebnem and Mesut prepare to bring Didem's world crashing down on her when she is most confident. Slandering Sebnem and Mesut, Didem will lose not only her reputation but also Onur. Aysel will strike the last blow to Didem, who does not give up despite all this. Thinking that they have destroyed Didem, Sebnem, Melisa, and Aysel will face an unexpected danger.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Onur wants to confront Macit and accept his guilt. Despite Sebnem's efforts to dissuade him from this decision, Onur is determined to take responsibility for his crime. For Macit, the time for revenge has come. The man who took the life of his son, Demir, is now within his grasp. Unhesitatingly, Macit confronts the truth, even if it means opposing Aysel. Not satisfied with Sebnem's methods to get rid of Didem, Melisa decides to use her own tactics. Unaware of the surprise awaiting her, Melisa sets her plan in motion. Caught in the midst of all this turmoil, Sebnem searches for ways to rectify the situation, only to be shocked by Didem's unexpected move.
